The climate in Dnipro

Dnipro is about 60 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 29°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −5°C. Around 560 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in April (about 68 mm). The highest temperature in Dnipro in 2015–2024 was 38°C (17 July 2016) and the lowest −26°C (8 January 2015).

Best time to visit Dnipro

The most pleasant weather in Dnipro is usually in June and September: average highs are between 23°C and 27°C, with up to 8 days of rain a month. In January and February nights are frosty (below −3°C on average) and snow is common.
